scope: Classic hierarchical list discovered automatically in an area-owned form: order, depth, expansion, selection, keyboard-driven selection and disclosure with the list's own events, reveal, VoiceOver navigation and operation; a multiple-selection list: its own selection, a user's Shift+Down extension published in full, and an accessibility selection replacing it

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixels: Each AX run compares the form, before any action, with the same window built without plugin, component or helpers: zero changed pixels below the title bar. Under Rosetta, interpreted, AppKit's window-title text differed by one antialiasing level in 430 pixels.

rejectedApproach: Pointer clicks at computed item points. After a half-line trackpad scroll, 4D reports the next whole line, and a click selected the item above the requested one. Keyboard selection and disclosure need no geometry.
notCovered: Extending a list's selection through accessibility: 4D extends it only while the physical Shift or Command key is down, which the bridge never posts
